title: Inspect action-panel software composition and hit mapping
platforms: Desktop source routines on Linux interpreter; actual GUI untested
changes: Record bounded diagnostic software composition and first-row coordinate round trips across the EUR action-menu reveal at two lengths.
validation: For each length, 33 visible recognized-menu samples mapped back to row zero; 39 frames including partial reveal had no recognized menu. Six protected ROM, snapshot and source hashes remained unchanged.
limitations: The first point was transparent and invalid; the corrected test derives its screen point from the menu hit geometry. It did not inject a mouse event or prove glyph alignment, GUI/GPU output, native Windows, Android or absence of underlying actions. Isolated build emitted three unused-code warnings.
